# Leadfeeder

Leadfeeder identifies companies visiting your website and converts them into high-value leads.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/leadfeeder/.

## Actions

- **Get Accounts**: Retrieve a list of accounts the user has access to.
- **Get All Visits**: Retrieve all visits for a specific lead.
- **Get Company Info by IP**: Retrieve company information based on an ip address.
- **Get Custom Feeds**: Retrieve a list of custom feeds for a specific account.
